slides.title: Two Inflation Reports
slides.body: BLS releases October consumer prices on Nov 10 and producer prices on Nov 13, both at 8:30 a.m. ET. Economists expect CPI up 0.3% on the month (core 0.2%). Estimates vary.

slides.title: Mortgage Rates, 3 Weeks Down
slides.subtitle: Freddie Mac 30-year average (%)
slides.body: Next weekly update: Thu, Nov 12. A year ago the rate was 6.22%. Bond auctions can move it.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Treasury sells 3-year (Mon), 10-year (Tue) and 30-year (Thu) debt at 1 p.m. ET. Weak demand can lift yields. Markets price roughly 75% odds of a December Fed hike (estimate).

slides.title: Save This: Week Checklist
items: Wed 11: Veterans Day, no BLS data, bond markets closed.
